images.scene: De oudsten leggen de handen op
images.alt: De oudsten leggen de handen op — 1 Timotheüs 4:14; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. 1 Timothy 4:14 recalls Timothy receiving a gift through prophecy with the laying on of hands by the elders. A respectful recalled event: young adult Timothy sits quietly in a modest first-century Ephesian home, three elderly male elders around him praying, one elder rests one hand lightly on each shoulder while the other two stand separately with their own hands clasped. Clear spacing and anatomically coherent arms, no tangle of many fingers over a head, no glowing magical effect. Timothy fully clothed, quiet dignity.

images.alt: Lesbeeld: de weduwe blijft bidden — 1 Timotheüs 5:5; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. 1 Timothy 5:5 describes a genuinely bereaved widow left alone, placing her hope in God and continuing in prayer by night and day. One elderly widow alone in her simple first-century room at dusk, a small oil lamp on the table, seated upright with hands together naturally, a quiet expression of trust. No poverty spectacle, grave, ghosts or invented deceased relative; a visual illustration of the described way of life, modest opaque clothing, two arms.

images.alt: Christus voor Pontius Pilatus — 1 Timotheüs 6:13; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. 1 Timothy 6:13 recalls Christ Jesus bearing the good confession before Pontius Pilate. Historically grounded scene of Jesus standing calmly before the seated Roman governor Pilate in a restrained first-century Roman Judean administrative courtyard. Jesus in a plain fully covering robe, governor in Roman tunic and toga at a raised stone seat, one quiet guard in background, no theatrical crowd, no injuries, crown of thorns or blood. Serious exchange and steadfast witness, no readable inscription. Three distinct people with coherent limbs.
